notes.note: Narration (no name box), same text as 0.7. Speakers from Quest018.bla with row = TextIdOffset+N+1 (Money Dopant +34 -> 0.35, Ankh +36 -> 0.37 and +40 -> 0.41).

Leader block 0.20-0.34 (TextIdOffset+19+k), Pt_Chara_Check order: Shotaro, OOO, Momotaros(22), RX, Rider 1, Mebius(25 polite), Zero(26), Taro, Ultraman, Seven, God Gundam(30, 'Fight'), Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero. 'Netsuki' rendered as 'heating up' so it reads as both crowd fervor and literal heat (Momotaros's ice-melting joke).
Event name 'Million Colosseo' kept distinct from the venue 'Colosseum' because the source uses the Italian form here; not in glossary.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36); same wording as the existing 'What a load of crap!!' line.

48/50 W (Philip), 49 W (Shotaro): the branch when W is in the party. Otherwise the leader block 0.55+k plays (0.55 Shotaro slot is empty): 56 OOO, 57 Momotaros, 58 RX, 59 Rider 1, 60 Mebius, 61 Zero, 62 Taro, 63 Ultraman, 64 Seven, 65 God, 66 Zeta, 67 Nu, 68 00, 69 Wing Zero. 'Yaru/yarimasu' rendered with 'we' since the leader accepts for the team.
Three-choice select window; kept as a newline list.

Match: Red King (89/93/97/99/103), Eleking (90/95/98/101), '???' announcer (91/92/94/96/100/102/104/105/106). Roars romanized from these specific cries (glossary Red King/Eleking roars are for different Japanese). Kaiju referred to as 'it' (glossary g=n). 'Discharge Ray' per the existing skill name.
Ring bell sound effect, no speaker; written as a quoted SFX per glossary style.

Money Dopant clicks his tongue on the win route; 112-126 leader block (TextIdOffset+111+k): 112 Shotaro, 113 OOO, 114 Momotaros, 115 RX, 116 Rider 1, 117 Mebius, 118 Zero, 119 Taro, 120 Ultraman, 121 Seven, 122 God, 123 Zeta (rest in quest_020).
